engine: macOS Vision VNRecognizeTextRequest accurate/en-US; no language correction
limitations: OCR and regex matching are imperfect; low-resolution/obscured/line-wrapped credentials can evade recognition.
Opaque token candidates are heuristic and can be false positives; only flagged pictures need visual review.
Zero pattern matches is not proof that an image contains no secret or patient content.
Only files in the Git-eligible snapshot are included; root's later store captures need their own provenance/final screen.
scope: Git-eligible PNG/JPG snapshot only; no user attachment paths or ignored raw screenshots/result/archive bundles; no recognized content or matching values serialized
